sessions.title: Psalm Reference Finder
sessions.theme: Identify the Psalm reference for familiar KJV excerpts.

rounds.title: Psalm 1:1
rounds.excerpt: Blessed is the man that walketh not in the counsel of the ungodly.
rounds.teachingNote: This opening verse begins the Psalter's contrast between two ways.

rounds.title: Psalm 1:3
rounds.excerpt: He shall be like a tree planted by the rivers of water.
rounds.teachingNote: The fruitful tree image belongs to Psalm 1.

rounds.title: Psalm 8:1
rounds.excerpt: O Lord our Lord, how excellent is thy name in all the earth!
rounds.teachingNote: Psalm 8 opens and closes with this praise.

rounds.title: Psalm 19:1
rounds.excerpt: The heavens declare the glory of God.
rounds.teachingNote: Psalm 19 begins with creation's testimony.

rounds.title: Psalm 19:14
rounds.excerpt: Let the words of my mouth, and the meditation of my heart, be acceptable in thy sight.
rounds.teachingNote: This prayer closes Psalm 19.

rounds.title: Psalm 23:1
rounds.excerpt: The Lord is my shepherd; I shall not want.
rounds.teachingNote: This is the opening line of Psalm 23.

rounds.title: Psalm 23:4
rounds.excerpt: Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil.
rounds.teachingNote: The valley line is from Psalm 23.

rounds.title: Psalm 24:1
rounds.excerpt: The earth is the Lord's, and the fulness thereof.
rounds.teachingNote: Psalm 24 declares the Lord's ownership.

rounds.title: Psalm 27:1
rounds.excerpt: The Lord is my light and my salvation; whom shall I fear?
rounds.teachingNote: Psalm 27 begins with fearless trust.

rounds.title: Psalm 34:8
rounds.excerpt: O taste and see that the Lord is good.
rounds.teachingNote: This invitation appears in Psalm 34.

rounds.title: Psalm 37:4
rounds.excerpt: Delight thyself also in the Lord.
rounds.teachingNote: Psalm 37 calls the faithful to delight in the Lord.

rounds.title: Psalm 46:1
rounds.excerpt: God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
rounds.teachingNote: The refuge confession begins Psalm 46.

rounds.title: Psalm 51:10
rounds.excerpt: Create in me a clean heart, O God.
rounds.teachingNote: This renewal prayer is from Psalm 51.

rounds.title: Psalm 56:3
rounds.excerpt: What time I am afraid, I will trust in thee.
rounds.teachingNote: Psalm 56 speaks trust in the face of fear.

rounds.title: Psalm 63:1
rounds.excerpt: O God, thou art my God; early will I seek thee.
rounds.teachingNote: Psalm 63 begins with seeking God.

rounds.title: Psalm 91:1
rounds.excerpt: He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most High.
rounds.teachingNote: Psalm 91 opens with shelter in the Most High.

rounds.title: Psalm 95:6
rounds.excerpt: O come, let us worship and bow down.
rounds.teachingNote: Psalm 95 invites worship and kneeling before the Lord.

rounds.title: Psalm 100:4
rounds.excerpt: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving.
rounds.teachingNote: Psalm 100 calls worshipers into thanksgiving.

rounds.title: Psalm 103:1
rounds.excerpt: Bless the Lord, O my soul.
rounds.teachingNote: Psalm 103 begins with this call to the soul.

rounds.title: Psalm 107:1
rounds.excerpt: O give thanks unto the Lord, for he is good.
rounds.teachingNote: Psalm 107 opens with thanks for goodness and mercy.

rounds.title: Psalm 118:24
rounds.excerpt: This is the day which the Lord hath made.
rounds.teachingNote: Psalm 118 calls for rejoicing in the Lord's day.

rounds.title: Psalm 119:11
rounds.excerpt: Thy word have I hid in mine heart.
rounds.teachingNote: Psalm 119 speaks of hiding the word in the heart.

rounds.title: Psalm 119:105
rounds.excerpt: Thy word is a lamp unto my feet.
rounds.teachingNote: Psalm 119 uses lamp and light imagery for the word.

rounds.title: Psalm 121:1-2
rounds.excerpt: My help cometh from the Lord, which made heaven and earth.
rounds.teachingNote: Psalm 121 identifies the source of help.

rounds.title: Psalm 139:14
rounds.excerpt: I am fearfully and wonderfully made.
rounds.teachingNote: Psalm 139 praises God's work in forming life.
